On PR 495's branch (head a2b8303f): when any of the five settings (FORCE_HYGIENE_WINDOW, FORCE_HYGIENE_BAND, FORCE_HYGIENE_BASELINE_WINDOWS, FORCE_GATEWAY_LATENCY_BUDGET_MS, FORCE_GATEWAY_BYPASS_COOLDOWN) falls back to its default, log one WARNING per process per variable naming the variable and the accepted range, NEVER the value or any part of it (C-582 no-echo rule), and list the variable names (names only, sorted, no values) in a new env_fallbacks field of the gateway /health. Behaviour otherwise unchanged: a bad value still falls back and the gateway starts; ceilings and ranges as built; explicit create_app arguments still win. Also close reviewer-7's A19 (assert state.latency_budget_ms == 5.0 for the explicit argument). Update the five rows in docs/ENVIRONMENT.md (the nothing is logged text becomes the warning and the field) and keep tools/environment_anchors.py --check at 0 wrong rows. Done when: tests that a junk value, a value over the ceiling, NaN and inf each give the default AND exactly one warning naming the variable AND an env_fallbacks entry, that the value (use a sentinel string) appears in no log line, no /health field and no exception text, that an unset or valid value gives no warning and an empty env_fallbacks; mutants (warning dropped, value echoed in the warning, env_fallbacks missing, one warning per request instead of per process, valid value warns) die; CI green, GX10 on the exact head. Do not touch PR 866 or its branch. Don-only and non-blocking (recommended as built): the ceilings and cooldown 0.
